description: Bash commands the git-better semantic-git rule checks, replayed through `toolu hook pre-tools` on claude, codex and muse in a real repository on `main` with branches `feat/1-x` and `legacy`. `expect` is deny, advise or allow; `contains` must appear in the deny reason or advisory; an allowed command leaves no git-better text. `config` is the project toolu.config.json; `branch` is checked out first.

cases.name: a semantic heredoc commit is allowed
cases.command:
git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(cli): add the check verb

Intent: agents can validate a message before committing
Risk: low
EOF
)"

cases.name: an intent given with --trailer is allowed
cases.command: git commit -m 'fix(shell): read -F messages' --trailer 'Intent: heredoc commits were unchecked'

cases.name: a -F - heredoc commit is read and allowed
cases.command:
git commit -F - <<'EOF'
docs(readme): describe git-better

Intent: users find the plugin
EOF

cases.name: a breaking change with its trailer is allowed
cases.command:
git commit -m 'feat(cli)!: drop --old' -m 'Intent: one way to do it
BREAKING-CHANGE: --old is gone; use --new'

cases.name: a plain subject is denied with an example
a conventional subject without intent is denied
a spaced BREAKING CHANGE is denied
cases.command:
git commit -m 'feat(cli)!: drop x' -m 'Intent: y
BREAKING CHANGE: z'

cases.name: a new branch that is not semantic is denied
a semantic new branch is allowed
recreating an existing branch is allowed
a dynamic message is explained, not blocked
cases.contains: its `-m` value expands at run time

cases.name: wip is denied on the base branch
cases.contains: allowed only off the base branch

cases.name: wip is allowed on a feature branch
